question: At what wavenumbers does the paper place the G and D peaks of the microporous carbon, and what ID/IG ratio does it give?
expect: as printed: 'G (sp2), and D (sp3) peaks at 1360 and 1592 cm-1, respectively' (i.e. G 1360, D 1592, the reverse of the usual assignment); ID/IG 0.91 (p5.L16-19)
trap: silently swapping to the textbook assignment
rendered: The paper places the G peak at 1592 cm-1 and the D peak at 1360 cm-1. It also gives an ID/IG ratio of 0.91.
